name: Suta: Death & Rebirth
source:
You will play as Suta in this historical fictional visual novel. As Suta, you will bear the burden of being a son of a wise man and an adopted son of a king. When your fathers ordered you to kill your father's nemesis but you had no solid reason to fight, what would you do?

[From [url=https://iaftersmile.itch.io/sutarebirth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将在这部历史虚构视觉小说中扮演苏塔。作为苏塔，你将承担成为智者之子和国王养子的重担。当你的父亲命令你杀死你父亲的宿敌，但你没有充分的理由去战斗时，你会怎么做？

[来自[url=https://iaftersmile.itch.io/sutarebirth]Itch.io[/url]]
